openingLine: Honestly, I'm done. Timur rewrote my whole module last night without a word to me. If my work can just be thrown away, why am I even here? Maybe the three of you can finish the demo without me.

turns.text: Let's fix this fast, the demo is in three days.
turns.characterLine: How do I know this will not happen again?

turns.text: From now on nobody changes someone's module without their review.
turns.characterLine: Will you make Timur the villain for this?

turns.text: I'll talk to him myself, you focus on work.
turns.characterLine: Who decides which version we keep for the demo?

turns.text: We assign owners now, freeze by Thursday, and run the full demo at six. After the demo we will keep reviews so nobody loses ownership again.
turns.characterLine: The Thursday run failed. What now?

turns.text: We'll work all night and fix it.
turns.characterLine: I will stay for the demo, but the team needs a safer recovery plan.
